meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: Claude 会先喊 “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”,拉起 5 个互相攻击的对抗成员做交叉批评,只保留经得起攻击的结论,再强制交给 plan agent 写成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出 “hyperplan”、“hpp” 等关键词,或规划需要暴露薄弱假设、盲点与过度设计时触发;需 team 工具可用,且在可担任 Lead 的主会话中运行。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我把这个重构方案做一次对抗式规划
say.note: 会启动 5 名对抗成员交叉批评

say.text: /hyperplan 我要给这个 API 加缓存,帮我把盲点挑出来
say.note: 成员互撕后,交给 plan agent 出计划

say.text: hpp:这个架构改动有多少过度设计,帮我想清楚
say.note: 只留下站得住脚的结论

howto.what_en: Claude first announces “HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!”, then spins up 5 mutually hostile team members for cross-critique, keeps only defensible insights, and mandatorily hands them to the `plan` agent to formalize an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers on “hyperplan”, “hpp” etc., or when planning must surface weak assumptions, blind spots and over-engineering. Requires team tools enabled and a lead-eligible main session.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to run an adversarial plan on this refactor
/hyperplan: add caching to this API and surface the blind spots
say_en.note: They debate, then the plan agent writes the plan

say_en.text: hpp: how much over-engineering is in this architecture change?
